facts.statement: The podcast's SOE Fan Faire 2007 segment included a Free Realms discussion item at 3:45 in the episode.
The podcast episode included a segment on Free Realms at 3:45, within coverage of SOE Fan Faire 2007 (held August 2-5 in Las Vegas).
SOE's 2008 Fan Faire was scheduled for August 14-17, 2008 at the Las Vegas Hilton in Las Vegas, Nevada, and included demos of upcoming SOE titles including Free Realms.

article_summaries.title: Ten Ton Hammer Podcast #4
article_summaries.summary: This is a Ten Ton Hammer podcast episode covering the week of August 20, 2007, mainly about Warhammer Online, Age of Conan, Legends of Norrath and The Agency. Free Realms appears only as a segment title (at 3:45) in the SOE Fan Faire 2007 discussion; the page gives no details about the game, so it offers nothing usable for quests, items, prices or mechanics.

article_summaries.title: SOE Sets Date for 2008 Fan Faire
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer news post reprinting SOE's press release announcing the 2008 Sony Online Entertainment Fan Faire. Free Realms is mentioned only in passing: demos of it, alongside The Agency and other upcoming SOE titles, were to be showcased at the event. Nothing about the game's mechanics, quests or items is described.
